summary.text: Paula Kay is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly who has represented District 100 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on the Democratic and People Over Politics Party lines in the November 3, 2026 general election; she is a lawyer and former legislative director.

paragraphs.text: Kay received a bachelor's degree in government from Wesleyan University and a law degree from Brooklyn Law School.

Her career experience includes working as a lawyer and legislative director, and as of 2025 she was affiliated with the Rock Hill Business and Community Organization and Rock Hill's Sullivan Renaissance Center.
Kay assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Aileen Gunther.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as Agriculture, Economic Development, Job Creation, Commerce and Industry, Insurance, Racing and Wagering, and Veterans' Affairs.
